This is textbook application + parameter substitution (weaving word + s1^2) yielding the least-interesting thin case, plus recomputation of known trefoil data. Certification/replay alone does not rescue it. No bounded addition can create a thick extremal on this thin ray or supply the missing substantive phenomenon without new research direction.
